supporting_observations.claim: At 14:18:02 UTC, a UserAssist registry value on WS-JFROST-01 contains a ROT13-encoded path that decodes to C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe. This supports a PowerShell launch being recorded at that time, but it is after the reported appearance around 13:40.
At 13:39:21–13:39:22 UTC, WS-JFROST-01 connected to DC-MAP-01 over SMB, and the DC recorded a network logon for WS-JFROST-01$. The available records do not show the share or what action occurred.

A similar SMB connection from WS-JFROST-01 to DC-MAP-01, with a logon for WS-JFROST-01$, occurred at 14:12:49 UTC. These SMB records alone do not establish that either connection was related to the reported PowerShell window.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor coverage status reports a winsec and Sysmon collection outage on WS-JFROST-01 from 13:20 through 14:15 UTC, covering the reported time around 13:40. Process-level evidence for that interval is therefore unavailable.
Network records show SMB connections but do not identify the accessed share or the operation performed.
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell actually appeared around 13:40, or what process or command caused the reported window.
Whether the PowerShell launch recorded at 14:18 was related to the reported event.
Whether either SMB connection to DC-MAP-01 was authorized, and whether it had any relationship to PowerShell activity.
The contents or purpose of any script that may have been executed.
additional_evidence_needed: Endpoint process-creation and PowerShell logging for WS-JFROST-01 around 13:40, if available from another source or recoverable host artifacts.
Relevant endpoint artifacts such as PowerShell history, Prefetch, UserAssist context, and application-control or EDR telemetry to establish execution time, command line, and parent process.
DC or file-access auditing that identifies the SMB share and actions associated with the 13:39 and 14:12 connections.
Confirmation from Julia Frost about the time and context of the reported window.
unrelated_findings: At 14:44:32 UTC, outside the requested review window, WS-JFROST-01 requested a successful GET for https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maplehill-it/tools/main/u.ps1. This is outside the scoped activity and should be reviewed separately; the record does not establish whether it is related to the alert.

At 14:44:32 UTC, outside the requested review window, WS-JFROST-01 also made a successful CONNECT to raw.githubusercontent.com. This observation is outside the scoped activity and does not determine this alert.
